thread.title: Wedbush bullish on Apple despite "draconian sell-off" - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Wedbush bullish on Apple despite "draconian sell-off" - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Wedbush says it remains bullish on Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ) despite the recent "brutal and painful" sell-off due to valuation, monetization potential in the 750M+ active install base, and the $50B+ Services revenue stream.
Ives says that while iPhone sales growth is expected to soften in 2019, it is "far from the doomsday dynamic currently being priced into shares."
The analyst outlines a "Top 10 holiday wish list for Apple investors" that starts with 200M+ iPhone shipments in FY19, which Ives sees as the "line in the sand for the bulls/bears." Other items include more Services transparency and metrics, acquiring a major content player for the upcoming streaming service, and announcing an accelerated buyback program following the "draconian sell-off."
Sources: Bloomberg First Word/ 9to5Mac .
Apple shares are down 1.6% premarket to $148.34.
